sourceText: Develop the agreed next Workstream B in order: solve unattended host stalls and candidate routing specificity without repeating the long convergence cycle.
normalizedOutcome: Unverified or silent unattended hosts are refused or terminated quickly with cleanup diagnostics, while productive hosts remain bounded; generic candidate terms no longer cause full-corpus scans and explicit sources remain selected.
acceptanceClaim: Deterministic focused tests show zero spawn for unready hosts, startup and total timeout cleanup with slot reacquisition, and bounded candidate routing that filters generic terms while preserving every protected explicit source.
